tools.Name: Claude Code
tools.Description: An agentic coding tool that resides in the terminal to execute routine tasks, explain complex code, and manage git workflows using natural language.
tools.Use_Case: Accelerating development cycles and automating terminal-based coding tasks.

tools.Name: VoiceStudio
tools.Description: An open-source, local-first alternative to ElevenLabs, providing voice cloning, dubbing, and transcription in over 600 languages.
tools.Use_Case: Creating audiobooks, local voice cloning, and automated video dubbing without API subscriptions.

tools.Name: TimesFM
tools.Description: A pretrained foundation model by Google Research designed for high-performance multivariate and univariate time-series forecasting.
tools.Use_Case: Predicting future data trends across various domains without needing per-task model tuning.
